pages.description: This page provides the administrative interface for managing your organization's partner hierarchy. You can view, edit, and organize partner categories and groups in a hierarchical tree format, allowing for a clear representation of your business structure.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're unsure how to proceed, remember that the main view is a hierarchical tree. To add new elements, click the 'New Partner Level' button. To explore the structure, use the expand/collapse icons next to each node. To modify an existing partner level, simply click on its row in the tree.
common_tasks: Creating partner levels: Click the 'New Partner Level' button at the top of the page to add new organizational nodes to your hierarchy.
Editing partner structure: Click on any existing tree node (row) to open its details for modification.
Managing hierarchy: Use the drag-and-drop functionality (if available) or the edit options to re-organize partner categories and groups within the tree.
Viewing organizational structure: Click the arrow icons next to parent nodes to expand or collapse sections of the tree, revealing or hiding sub-levels.
Administrative management: Utilize the tree structure to define and configure relationships between different parts of your organization.
troubleshooting: Problem: Cannot find a specific partner level → Solution: Try expanding all parent nodes to reveal hidden sub-levels. If still not found, it might not exist or is under a different parent than expected.
Problem: 'New Partner Level' button is disabled → Solution: Ensure you have the necessary permissions to create new levels. Contact your administrator if you believe this is an error.
help_guidance.getting_started: Welcome to the Partner Tree management page! To begin, familiarize yourself with the existing organizational structure displayed in the tree view. Your first task might be to add a new top-level category by clicking 'New Partner Level', or to expand existing nodes to see their sub-categories.
